description:
Thetis, the princess of the Carnes Empire, was dreaming about her wedding to her beloved fiancée Romaine.

One night, Theodore, the brother of Thetis, is falsely accused of being a traitor and killed due to a seal that his parents hastily gave to his fiancée at the request of his fiancée that he had been attacked by an enemy country.
Her fiancée Romain coveted the throne and used Thetis to kill all the imperial family and usurp the throne.

Thetis, who was imprisoned in a monastery by Romaine, who became emperor, despaired and tried to take her own life, but decided to take revenge and returned to the capital.
In front of Thetis, who has been forced to become empress by Romaine, a forgotten face appears.

The appearance of this man was not in my plans. No, it shouldn't have been.

I don't know if an old relationship that has gone apart intervenes in my revenge.

**Original Novel:**  
R15: [Naver](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=10728606), [Kakao](https://page.kakao.com/content/67443117)
